literal: Daozong, Part Three
idiomatic: Daozong, Part Three

literal: In the eighth year, spring, first month, on guimao day, Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable Yelü Chao and others memorialized victory on the northern border.
idiomatic: In the eighth year, on guimao day of the first spring month Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable Yelü Chao and others memorialized victory on the northern border.

literal: Because the fighting had killed many, monks were fed at Nanjing and the Central Capital.
idiomatic: Because the fighting had killed many, monks were fed at Nanjing and the Central Capital.

literal: On jiashen day went to Yuer Marsh.
idiomatic: On jiashen day the court went to Yuer Marsh.

literal: On renyin day dull fog lasted many days.
idiomatic: On renyin day dull fog lasted many days.

literal: Second month, on bingchen day Northern and Southern Privy Councils said there was nothing to memorialize.
idiomatic: On bingchen day of the second month the Northern and Southern Privy Councils said there was nothing to memorialize.

literal: On renxu day, for merit in attacking the northern tribes, Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable Yelü Chao was made to administer Northern Court great king affairs; inspector-general Xiao Aludai Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable, promoted Left Defender of the Gate Commandant upper general.
idiomatic: On renxu day, for merit in attacking the northern tribes, Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable Yelü Chao was made to administer Northern Court great king affairs; inspector-general Xiao Aludai was made Wugu Dilie tribe detail-stable and promoted Left Defender of the Gate Commandant upper general.

literal: On wuchen day there was famine that year; Wuan Prefecture rent and tax were remitted, and people in En, Yu, Shun, and Hui prefectures were relieved.
idiomatic: On wuchen day there was famine that year; Wuan Prefecture rent and tax were remitted, and people in En, Yu, Shun, and Hui prefectures were relieved.

idiomatic: On guimao day of the third month the relevant offices memorialized that more than three thousand people in Chun, Tai, and Ningjiang prefectures wished to become monks and nuns and receive full precepts; permission was granted.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on renzi day, relieved people in Yi and Rao prefectures.
idiomatic: On renzi day of the fourth summer month people in Yi and Rao prefectures were relieved.

literal: On dingsi day halted at Talishe.
idiomatic: On dingsi day the court halted at Talishe.

literal: On jimao day summered at Tuogulie.
idiomatic: On jimao day the court summered at Tuogulie.

idiomatic: On dingchou day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On bingshen day relieved hungry people in Rao Prefecture.

literal: On a ding day, because of the Kunning Festival, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

idiomatic: On yihai day of the ninth month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.
